editorial.intent: Establish the product and the problem in one readable action.
editorial.information_delta: The viewer learns where the product is used and what changes.
editorial.cut_reason: Cut when the hand releases the old state and attention moves to the product.

frame.shot_size: medium wide, full hand action visible
frame.composition: product right of center with look room left

action.start: Hand rests on the old object at frame right.
action.primary: Hand lifts the old object and places the product in the same clear zone.
action.end: Product is centered and fully visible before the cut.

camera.motivation: Keep the hand contact and product change readable.

continuity.screen_direction: action enters from frame right and settles center
continuity.lighting: soft key camera-left; practical remains behind product

acceptance.criterion: Product geometry and label remain unchanged.
Hands make plausible contact and the object does not teleport.
